headline: PM Narendra Modi Inaugurates The Nitish Setu Bridge In Bihar
seoTitle: PM Narendra Modi Inaugurates Nitish Setu Bridge In Bihar
metaDescription: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has officially opened the newly constructed Nitish Setu bridge in Bihar, which connects the Patna and Vaishali districts.
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the six-lane, 9.76-kilometer Nitish Setu bridge spanning the Ganga river.
The infrastructure project links Kachhi Dargah in Patna to Bidupur in Vaishali and was completed at a cost of 5,500 crore rupees.
The naming of the bridge has prompted questions from opposition figures, who have expressed concerns regarding the decision.
aiContextParagraph: On November 21, 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Bihar to inaugurate the Nitish Setu bridge, an infrastructure project spanning the Ganga river. The bridge consists of a 9.76-kilometer main structure and 10 kilometers of approach roads, serving as a vital connection between Kachhi Dargah in the Patna district and Bidupur in the Vaishali district. Built over a period of 14 years with an investment of 5,500 crore rupees, the facility is intended to enhance regional transport and improve connectivity between north and south Bihar. While the inauguration highlighted the government's development efforts in the state, the naming of the bridge has become a point of contention. Opposition representatives have publicly questioned the choice of name, suggesting it may overlook certain cultural or communal sentiments, adding a layer of political sensitivity to the project's launch.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to rapid coverage across multiple national news outlets and the political discourse surrounding the naming of the major infrastructure project.
